claim_ceiling: This stop rule establishes only that additional near-identical qualification or characterization on the unchanged NVIDIA provider path is not scientifically justified for the purpose of releasing Ontology 007R1. It does not establish persistent NVIDIA instability, a provider failure rate, a backend root cause, a request-shape cause, max-token causation, Ontology 007R1 semantic correctness or incorrectness, canonical institutional meaning, Institutional IR, production readiness, architecture change, or cross-provider behavior.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: The provider endpoint identity, routing surface, or versioned service implementation materially changes.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A tracked evidence artifact identifying the old and new provider-path state and why the change is relevant to the observed failure surface.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: The exact provider model identity or version changes.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A tracked model/provider compatibility record and a new separately preregistered qualification.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: The OIC NVIDIA provider adapter changes in a way that can materially affect transport, timeout, response handling, or request execution.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A new adapter digest plus tests establishing the bounded transport-relevant delta.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: The provider supplies independently inspectable evidence of an incident resolution or service change relevant to the observed timeout/provider-error surface.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A tracked source record identifying the provider statement and its relevance to this exact path.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: The controlled execution environment changes materially at the network, region, routing, client, or transport layer.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A frozen before/after environment description showing the specific path-level delta.

material_reopen_conditions.condition: A different provider or materially different endpoint is selected for the same semantic target.
material_reopen_conditions.required_evidence: A new provider-path work order and fresh target-bound qualification design.

next_authorized_activity: Proceed with unrelated offline OIC work. The exact NVIDIA provider path remains blocked for Ontology 007R1 until a material reopen condition is established and independently verified.
non_reopen_conditions: Desire to obtain a passing qualification.
One or more ad-hoc successful calls.
Adding retries after a frozen failure.
Reusing accepted observations from Q009, RS002, Localization001, or Q010.
Running the same endpoint/model/adapter qualification again without a material change.

reopen_protocol.step_1: Establish at least one material reopen condition with a tracked evidence artifact.
reopen_protocol.step_2: Independently verify that the claimed material change is real and relevant to the provider path.
reopen_protocol.step_3: Preregister a new successor qualification work order. No work-order number is pre-authorized by this stop rule.
reopen_protocol.step_4: Freeze a fresh target-bound population before any live call.
reopen_protocol.step_5: Execute at most once under the new frozen rule.
reopen_protocol.step_6: Formally close and independently verify the successor result before considering 007R1 authorization.
